subtitle: Lesson 86 · What a real migration has to address

code:
-- SQL Server:
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM Orders
ORDER BY OrderDate DESC;

-- Oracle (older):
SELECT * FROM Orders
WHERE ROWNUM <= 10;  -- applies before ORDER BY!

-- Oracle 12c+:
SELECT * FROM Orders
ORDER BY OrderDate DESC
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;
caption: ROWNUM filters before the sort — a common source of wrong results.

code:
-- SQL Server:
CREATE TABLE Orders (
  OrderID INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY);

-- Oracle 12c+:
CREATE TABLE Orders (
  OrderID NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY
  PRIMARY KEY);

-- Older Oracle: needs a SEQUENCE
-- plus a BEFORE INSERT trigger.
caption: Know the target Oracle version before estimating this piece.
